# ProductNow MCP

Search ProductNow company context and manage documents, folders, versions, comments and media through its official user-authenticated MCP server.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/productnow-mcp/.

## Actions

- **Archive**: Put documents or folders away, including several at once.
- **Comment on document**: Leave feedback on a document that is in review.
- **Create document**: Create a NEW ProductNow document and generate its content with AI.
- **Create folder**: Create a NEW folder only when no existing folder fits.
- **Edit document**: Edit an existing ProductNow document.
- **Fetch** (read-only): Read one document you already have an id for.
- **Fetch folder** (read-only): List a folder you already have an id for, or the warehouse root.
- **Get status** (read-only): After edit_document or create_document, check whether the document is still being edited or the edits have finished.
- **List document versions** (read-only): List every version of a document when the user asks what changed, or you need an older version before calling fetch.
- **Move**: Move documents or folders into another folder, including several at once.
- **Remember**: Store one piece of information in ProductNow when the user says 'remember this', 'save this', or 'note that…' about their company,…
- **Rename**: Change a document or folder's name.
- **Reply to thread**: Reply to an existing comment thread on a document, posted as the user's personal agent.
- **Search** (read-only): Search the company's shared context — its intranet of documents, decisions, meeting notes, and synced systems — and return excerpts…
- **Update document status**: Change a document's lifecycle when the user wants a snapshot, a review, or to publish.
- **Upload media**: Upload a media file (image or video) to ProductNow storage.
